text.p: Following are the matches in the 20th round of the French first division championship on Thursday and Friday (standings in brackets, all kick-off times GMT):

Jean-Pierre Papin's side have hit rich scoring vein -- 11 goals in three games -- they will want to maintain against Metz team equal on points but with one eye on Tuesday's UEFA clash at Newcastle United.

Monaco, who have midfielder Ali Benarbia suspended, can take over at top with victory or join leaders Paris St-Germain on 39 points with draw. Montpellier, who have drawn last three games, are struggling to to climb out of four-team relegation zone.
Leaders PSG, with only one point from last two games, must win to keep Monaco at bay. Caen have not won or scored in four matches.

Bastia are on a roll with four successive victories and team's top scorer Anton Drobnjak back in business with two goals in 2-1 away win over champions Auxerre on Saturday. Guingamp are unbeaten in three games.

Auxerre need league results to match European Cup success and get back on winning track after taking only one point from last four games. But Lille are strong at home having lost there just once against Monaco a month ago.
Strasbourg, whose home record is second only to Rennes, face Lyon side with only one win, two months ago, and 22 goals conceded in 10 away games.
Promoted Marseille are unbeaten in four matches including 0-0 draw at PSG last week. North coast club Le Havre won 3-0 at Nice on their previous trip to the Mediterranean two weeks back.
Nantes can equal PSG's record of 13 games unbeaten in season. Cannes have scored only four goals in last 10 games, 2-0 win over Caen on Saturday ending run of nine games without victory.
Lens have lost last four games, conceding 10 goals. Nancy have not scored in three.
With one point in six games and average two goals against per match, Nice could reverse trend against Rennes, best home team with 23 points out of 27, but worst away with two out of 30.
